description: The Classical Dutch builds the traditional ...e6 and ...d5 center with the dark-squared bishop developed to e7. Play revolves around Black's thematic ...Ne4 and ...f4 pawn breaks against White's queenside expansion — a strategic battle of pawn levers rather than tactics.

lines.description: After 1.d4 f5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2, Black builds the classical center with 3...e6, developing with 4...d5 after 4.Nf3. White castles 5.O-O and Black develops 5...Be7, completing kingside development before striking. White expands with 6.c4 and Black castles 6...O-O. The middlegame turns on Black's ...Ne4 outpost and the ...f4 break versus White's pressure on the queenside and e5 square.
